question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Incompetence
solution:
The correct answer is **option (4) **i.e. **'Efficient'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Incompetence: **(अक्षमता) Lack of ability or skill to perform a task or job effectively.

 
 
• **Example:** Her **incompetence **in managing finances led to the company's financial problems.
 
 
 
• **Efficient:** (कुशल) Achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or resources.
 
 
• **Example: **The new software made our work process more **efficient**.
 
 
 
• Hence, **'Efficient' **is the most appropriate antonym for** 'Incompetence'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Efficient'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Caustic: (**कटु) Sarcastic or harsh in tone, often with the intent to criticize or hurt someone.

 
 
• **Example:** His caustic remarks offended some of his coworkers.
 
 
 
• **Interfere: **(हस्तक्षेप करना) To become involved in a situation where one is not wanted or needed.
 
 
• **Example:** Please don't interfere in our family matters.
 
 
 
• **Attitude:** (दृष्टिकोण) A settled way of thinking or feeling about something.
 
 
• **Example: **Having a positive attitude can lead to better outcomes in life.
